title: Barkbound Brute

steps.prompt: A monster shaped like a very broad heavy man: an empty suit of thick rusty plate armour split open by a tree trunk growing through it, huge bark shoulders, thick root arms bursting from the gauntlets, a dented great helm with a crown of small dead branches and two gold glows inside, moss and mushrooms on the back, clearly more tree than metal. Close-fitting shapes. No cloak, no cape, nothing held in the hands, no loose hanging cloth, arms well clear of the body, empty hands. Full-body character design for a game model, one person standing perfectly straight and facing the viewer in a strict T-pose, both arms held straight out horizontally to the sides at shoulder height with palms down and fingers together, legs straight and slightly apart, exactly front view, symmetrical, whole body in frame from head to feet and from fingertip to fingertip with margin, plain flat white background, even shadowless lighting, realistic adult body proportions about seven and a half heads tall, normal sized head and hands. High-end anime fantasy RPG key visual, stylised 3D look with painterly textures, soft cel shading with warm bounce light and cool rim light, detailed ornate equipment with engraved metal, layered cloth and leather, realistic proportions, expressive anime faces, lush bright colours with luminous highlights, original design, no photorealism, no text, no watermark, no logo.

steps.version: trellis_2_bf16 with shape and texture VAEs and dino_v3_vit_l (Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2), BiRefNet background removal inside the workflow, ComfyUI 0.39.0 built-in nodes

cleanup: Automatic only, by tools/pipeline/blender_finish_model.py: stood upright, welded, decimated to 12000 triangles, smart UV unwrap, vertex colours baked to a 2048 px texture, scaled so the longest side is 2.2 m, origin at the centre of the base.

Automatic only, by tools/pipeline/blender_rig_body.py: seams welded; scaled to the skeleton's height; arms raised level and legs brought together to a T-pose (measured: arms 52.2 degrees below level, legs 12.7 degrees out); arms scaled 0.774 along their length; automatic weights to the skeleton's body bones, fingers excluded.

notes: Input image: stylekit/golden/f1/con_rig_enm_barkbound_brute.png. The concept image went through TRELLIS.2 (BiRefNet cut-out, shape, texture, remesh, reduce to about 40,000 triangles, unwrap, bake), then Blender reduced it to the budget and re-baked the texture. Measured: source_tris=11152 final_tris=11152 dims=1.797x0.841x2.200 tex=2048. Rigged: the file holds the mesh bound to the CC0 Mesh2Motion human skeleton, so the clips in anm_human_basic drive it. Fingers do not bend. Judged from rendered test poses only; not yet seen in the headset.
